notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creature tokens.
description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that has flying due to Toby.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.
